recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,291.10 (+0.58%) and the Sensex at 82,104.79 (+0.63%); Bank Nifty moved +0.89%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +0.38%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -0.41%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.94%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹4,865 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹3,519 cr (provisional, NSE).
FMCG led the sectors (+1.87%), while Pharma lagged (-1.53%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Belrise Industries (+9.24%); biggest faller was Kaynes Technology India (-13.12%). Breadth: 176 advances vs 324 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 1.20% and the Nasdaq down 1.81%.
The rupee is at 93.91 per dollar, Brent at $93.43 (-2.51%) and gold at $3,869 (-0.45%).
